title: Hetzner auction
description: Hetzner's server auction as the auction watcher records it, read from its views (README, Hetzner auction).

panels.description: The auction watcher's views, through the data source Hetzner auction (README, Hetzner auction); their columns are described in platform/auction-watch/README.md. Every view is asked here, once a refresh, and the other blocks read these frames. Live now: offers in the feed. One card per limit of rules.json: the cheapest live offer of its shape (RAM and NVMe), green with ▼ when it is under the limit, otherwise how far over; and how many live offers have that shape. Met the limits: offers that went in the last 7 days at a price that met each limit. 64 GB NVMe, median today: the median price of the 64 GB offers with NVMe that went today, a UTC day. Feed: how long since the watcher last saw the feed answer, fresh under 2 minutes, late under 15, stale past that.

panels.title: Prices · EUR a month, without VAT
64 GB · median and lowest a day
panels.description: Each UTC day, the median and the lowest price of the 64 GB offers that went that day, with NVMe (cyan) and without (violet): the median solid, the lowest dashed (groups-daily). A day when none went is a gap. The dashed grey line is the operator's limit for 64 GB (limits).

panels.title: 128 GB · median and lowest a day
panels.description: Each UTC day, the median and the lowest price of the 128 GB offers that went that day, with NVMe (cyan) and without (violet): the median solid, the lowest dashed (groups-daily). A day when none went is a gap. The dashed grey line is the operator's limit for 128 GB (limits).

panels.title: 64 GB · under the limit a day
panels.description: Each UTC day, how many offers went at a price that met the 64 GB limit (bars), and the lowest price an offer of its shape went for, whatever its price (line), against the limit (dashed). From limits-daily.

panels.title: 128 GB · under the limit a day
panels.description: Each UTC day, how many offers went at a price that met the 128 GB limit (bars), and the lowest price an offer of its shape went for, whatever its price (line), against the limit (dashed). From limits-daily.

panels.title: How long offers last
panels.description: Of the offers that went, by when half and three quarters of them had gone, and how many went in under two minutes, by the price they went for and by the operator's limits (price and shape; the datacenter filters are not applied). From lifetimes, which counts only the offers the pod itself saw appear, since 2026-11-22: the older rows, the seed's, were sampled every five minutes, too coarse for a lifetime, and the offers already in the feed at the pod's first read are left out.

panels.title: Appeared and gone a day
panels.description: Offers that appeared and offers that went each UTC day, and how many were live at its end (flow-daily). Before 2026-11-22 a day's appeared comes from the seed's rows, sampled every five minutes, so an offer that came and went between two samples is missing; the record's first day and the pod's first read count what was already in the feed.

panels.title: Datacenters
panels.description: Live offers and the offers that went in the last 30 days, with their median price, by datacenter (datacenters). Only from the offers whose body the record kept, the ones the pod itself saw since 2026-11-22: the older rows, the seed's, were sampled every five minutes and carry no datacenter.

defaults.noValue: no offers with a datacenter yet

panels.title: Live offers, furthest under their usual price first
panels.description: Every offer in the feed now (live). Usual: its kind's usual price, the median over the watcher's window; under usual: how far under it, ▼ under, ▲ over, green at 20 % or more, the watcher's own threshold for a bargain. Limit: the operator's limits it meets. The offer's number opens it at Hetzner, in a new tab.

panels.title: Kinds with the most offers
panels.description: The kinds with a usual price (kinds), the most offers in the watcher's window first: the usual price, the median of the window; how many offers of the kind it holds; how many are live; and the cheapest live one.

defaults.noValue: no kind with a usual price yet
